business_problem: GPT Group needed to move ESG reporting off spreadsheets, PDFs, and disconnected legacy tools so it could manage energy, water, waste, and emissions data at portfolio scale, meet compliance reporting obligations, and make faster sustainability decisions.
solution_summary: GPT standardized environmental data management on IBM Envizi ESG Suite so sustainability information could be captured, normalized, tagged, and reused like finance-grade operational data. Starting in 2011, the company used Envizi to consolidate more than ten separate systems that had previously held utility and emissions data, then expanded the deployment with Interval Meter Analytics and Sustainability Program Tracking to manage improvement programs as well as reporting. Data from building assets now flows through Envizi into environmental management systems, dashboards, and external reporting frameworks such as NGERS, GRI, and NABERS, while support documents and audit evidence stay linked to the same records. Because the platform supports both high-level account reporting and granular sub-meter analysis, GPT can use one source of truth for compliance, procurement, portfolio optimization, and the public-facing GPT Environmental Dashboard instead of rebuilding datasets for each audience.

solution_components.name: IBM Envizi ESG Suite
solution_components.role: Serves as the central system for ESG data capture, normalization, reporting, and audit support across GPT’s asset portfolio.

solution_components.name: IBM Envizi Interval Meter Analytics
solution_components.role: Adds meter-level analytics that help GPT identify and manage sustainability improvement opportunities.

solution_components.name: IBM Envizi Sustainability Program Tracking
solution_components.role: Tracks ongoing sustainability initiatives and their outcomes against GPT’s baseline targets.

data_flow: Environmental data from energy, water, waste, and emissions sources is normalized in Envizi, tagged for multiple reporting frameworks, pushed into management dashboards and environmental systems, and reused for audit evidence, executive reporting, public dashboards, and sustainability-program tracking.
integration_points: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting scheme (NGERs)
business_outcome: GPT turned ESG information into a reusable operational asset, cutting energy intensity and utility cost, reducing emissions sharply, and giving internal teams, auditors, and executives trusted sustainability data they can act on quickly.
metrics: 52% reduction in energy intensity across the portfolio
USD 20 million annual savings on energy and water costs
82% reduction in emissions on its 2005 baseline
nearly USD 50 million increase annually in energy cost avoided
first of 864 real estate companies in the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment
